'''Pierce''' (Japanese: '''フリント''' ''Flint'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}. He is a member of [[Team Rocket]].

==History==
[[File:Pierce.png|thumb|left|250px|Pierce in {{aniseries|BW}}]]
Pierce was first mentioned in ''[[BW009|The Bloom Is on Axew!]]'' as being sent by {{an|Giovanni}} to help [[Jessie]], [[James]], and {{MTR}} in a mission. In ''[[BW010|A Rival Battle for Club Champ!]]'', when Jessie, James and Meowth were intercepted by [[Officer Jenny]] and the other police officers, Pierce came in driving a truck and drove away with the trio. Officer Jenny and the police followed until they came across a half-constructed road. The truck pushed on and toppled into the ground below and exploded. However the group escaped with jetpacks, and Pierce later gave them a briefcase and flew off.

In ''[[BW011|A Home for Dwebble!]]'', Pierce gave the trio orders to head to a [[Antimony Research Lab|research facility]]. He then met up with them again, where Jessie handed him the data he wanted. He met the trio once again in ''[[BW014|A Night in the Nacrene City Museum!]]'' in [[Nacrene City]] and gave them orders about the dummy meteorite they received in ''[[BW012|Here Comes the Trubbish Squad!]]''.

In ''[[BW017|Scraggy-Hatched to be Wild!]]'', Pierce told the trio to meet him. He appeared in a helicopter and the trio jumped in. Aboard, he introduced [[Dr. Zager]] who examined the meteorite and told them that the materials were not from this world.

In ''[[BW022|A Venipede Stampede!]]'', Pierce, Jessie, James, Meowth, and Dr. Zager finally found the [[Meteonite]] at the [[Desert Resort]]. He was set to make an appearance in the two [[BW023 (unaired)|following]] [[BW024 (unaired)|episodes]], in which, after helping to secure the Meteonite from [[Relic Castle]], he was to depart back to [[Kanto]] alongside Giovanni and Dr. Zager, but these episodes [[Banned episodes|never aired]] and have since been retconned out of [[Canon|continuity]]. He has not been seen or mentioned since.

==Character==
Pierce takes his job as an agent very seriously, and as a result, he obtained a high rank within Team Rocket. He often acts as a handler for the trio, passing on information and assignments from Giovanni when they cannot contact him themselves. He also brings Giovanni information obtained as a result of the trio's missions. Pierce tends to be impressed whenever the trio does well, and he does not hesitate to compliment them for it.

==Trivia==
[[File:Pierce uniform.png|thumb|140px|Pierce's uniform in [[BW023 (unaired)|the unaired BW023]]]]
* Pierce's Japanese name, Flint, is the English name of both an [[Elite Four]] member and [[Brock (anime)|Brock]]'s father.
* Pierce's Team Rocket uniform has a unique design, but due to his usually wearing a trench coat and the skipping of his [[BW023 (unaired)|final]] [[BW024 (unaired)|two]] appearances, it is never fully seen in any of the aired episodes. It appears in ''[[BW022|A Venipede Stampede!]]'', but it can only be seen from the back.
